description: This Dart source file defines a MenuProvider class and related data models for a Flutter application. The file manages loading, updating, and providing menu data (categories and items) from a local database, supporting offline access and real-time updates. It includes classes for menu categories and items, and the MenuProvider class offers methods to load menu data, update prices, and upsert items, functioning as a change notifier in Flutter for UI updates.

classes.name: MenuCategory
classes.description: Represents a menu category with id, name, and sort order.

classes.name: MenuItemModel
classes.description: Represents a menu item with details such as id, categoryId, name, description, image URL, spice level, allergens, nutrition info, base price, and portion options. Includes a method for calculating price based on portion size.

classes.name: MenuProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that loads menu categories and items from a local database, provides accessors for categories and items per category, and methods to load, update prices, and upsert menu items.

methods.name: loadMenu
methods.description: Loads menu categories and items from the local database and sorts categories by their sort order.

methods.name: updatePrice
methods.description: Updates the base price of a menu item and reloads the menu to reflect the change.

methods.name: upsertItem
methods.description: Inserts or updates a menu item in the database and then reloads the menu.

methods.name: _rowToItem
methods.description: Converts a database row into a MenuItemModel instance.
